candidate_relations.reason: Retinal degeneration is a nonspecific parent of outer-retinal loss and omits lightning-induced delayed cystoid maculopathy.
Solar retinopathy is related photic outer-retinal injury with a conflicting light-source etiology.
Electrically-induced retinal damage is the injury family and omits delayed-onset cystoid macular abnormalities.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: electrical retinal damage missing delayed cystoid maculopathy

candidate_relations.reason: Lightning-induced cataract is the later posterior subcapsular cataract, not the retinopathy object.
Berlin’s edema is acute commotio retinae and conflicts with delayed-onset cystoid macular abnormalities.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Berlin edema vs delayed cystoid lightning retinopathy

candidate_relations.reason: Traumatic optic neuropathy is unsupported without RAPD and is not macular lightning injury.
Posterior subcapsular cataract is an associated delayed finding, not the retinopathy.
Optic neuropathy is not supported by symmetric pupils without RAPD.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: optic neuropathy vs macular lightning injury

candidate_relations.reason: Photoreceptor/ellipsoid-zone damage is an OCT component and omits lightning etiology plus delayed cystoid change.
Solitary hyporeflective inner retinal spot is a late OCT finding, not the full diagnosis.
Lightning-induced macular edema captures cystoid fluid but omits delayed-onset retinopathy as the full object.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: lightning macular edema missing delayed retinopathy composite
